classes.name: Psion
classes.description: A psionic reality-bender who harnesses an otherworldly mental force, Psions wield the power of the mind through psionic disciplines fueled by psi points. Their powers are suppressed by antimagic fields and can be dispelled with dispel magic. They are only affected by counterspell when recreating the effect of a spell. Checks made to dispel, counter, or identify psionic spellcasting are made with disadvantage unless the other caster also has the Psionics feature. Detect Magic reveals psionic activity as mysterious untyped power. When recreating a spell through psionics, the spell has no verbal or material components, but all psionic abilities require somatic components and cause the psion to glow with psionic energy.

features.name: Psionic Archetype
features.description: At 1st level, choose a Psionic Archetype. Your choice grants features at 1st level and again at 3rd, 6th, 10th, and 14th level. Available archetypes are listed as subclasses of Psion (Awakened Mind, Unleashed Mind, Transcended Mind, Shaper's Mind, Wandering Mind, Elemental Mind, Consuming Mind, and Knowing Mind).

features.name: Psionics
features.description:
You gain a psionic discipline from your archetype. A discipline grants a passive feature, an active psionic power fueled by psi points, and the ability to recreate certain spells. You gain a second discipline at 3rd level and a third discipline at 18th level.

Psionic powers are suppressed by antimagic fields and can be dispelled with dispel magic. They are only affected by counterspell when recreating a spell. Detect Magic detects psionic activity but not its nature.

Your psionic ability is Intelligence.

Psionic save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier.

Psionic attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Psionic Talents
features.description: Pick two psionic talents. You gain additional talents at 5th, 7th, 9th, 12th, 15th, and 18th level. Whenever you level up, you can replace one previously selected psionic talent with another.

features.name: Secondary Discipline
features.description: Choose a second psionic discipline you do not already know. You gain all features of the selected discipline.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

features.name: Psionic Mastery
features.description: At the start of each of your turns, you gain 1 free psi point. This free psi point can only be spent to empower psionic disciplines, not to recreate spells or fuel Psionic Talents. Any unspent free psi point is lost at the end of your turn. This increases to 2 free psi points at 11th level and 3 free psi points at 17th level.

features.name: Ascension
features.description: If you die, you can choose to become an incorporeal entity on the Border Ethereal at the start of your next turn. You use a ghost's physical ability scores and abilities but retain your mental ability scores and psion class abilities. Your current and maximum hit points become those of the ghost. If you have fewer than 10 psi points when assuming this form, you instead have 10 psi points. You cannot rest while in this form. If you expend all psi points or the ghost is destroyed, you die normally.

features.name: Rampaging Power
features.description:
You gain a d4 Rampage Die. Once on each of your turns when making a damage roll, you can add the die to the damage roll. If you dealt damage during your last turn, the die becomes a d6, increasing by one die step for each subsequent turn you deal damage, up to a d12. If you did not deal damage during your last turn or become Incapacitated, it becomes a d4 again. If you maintain a continuous d12 Rampage Die for more than 1 minute, you gain 1 level of Exhaustion.

Rampage Die runs on the sheet: Turn Start steps it up after a turn you dealt damage and resets it to d4 after a turn without damage or while Incapacitated. Weapon damage rolls and damaging power uses mark the turn automatically, the die can only be added to one damage roll per turn, and holding d12 for 10 rounds adds a level of Exhaustion.

features.name: Primordial Aspect
features.description:
As an action, or when you deal fire, cold, or lightning damage without an action, you take on that element’s aspect until the end of your next turn or until you take a new aspect.
  • Cold. You gain an icy shell, reducing nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage you take by your proficiency bonus.
  • Fire. You gain a fiery aura. Once per turn, a creature within 5 feet that hits you with a melee attack takes fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus.
  • Lightning. Your walking speed increases by 5 feet.
You can spend 1 psi point to gain resistance to the chosen element until the start of your next turn. If you are specialized in that element, doing so costs no psi points.

features.name: Living Power
features.description:
When you use a Psychokinesis power or alternate effect, you can apply one of the following modifiers:
  • Controlled Power. When a spell or power targets an area, choose a number of creatures equal to the psi points spent in the area to be ignored. The power passes harmlessly around them; they automatically succeed on saving throws and take no damage when they would normally take half damage on a successful save.
  • Raging Power. When you roll damage for the power or spell, reroll a number of dice up to 1 plus the psi points spent. You must use the new rolls.
  • Shaped Power. You can convert a ranged spell attack into a melee spell attack, such as by forming it into a weapon. You can also form a melee spell attack into a shape and hurl it at a target within 15 feet as a ranged spell attack.

class_resources.name: Psi Points
class_resources.description: A spendable pool used to fuel psionic discipline powers and effects. Regains all spent points on a short or long rest.

class_resources.name: Psi Limit
class_resources.description: The maximum number of psi points that can be spent at one time.

class_resources.name: Psionic Talents Known
class_resources.description: Number of Psionic Talents you know (from known disciplines).

class_resources.name: Balance of Power
class_resources.description: Bank HP restored or temporary HP granted by psionic abilities into this pool (max = Psion level). Expend the pool on a damage roll within 1 minute.
